name: TrueNAS
author: Vinícius Lourenço
description: TrueNAS pool health, disk temperatures, active alerts and protection tasks on the Omarchy bar, with desktop notifications and a popout for disks, pools, alerts, services, apps, protection, shares, network and system state.

barWidget.description: Pool health, disk temperatures, alerts, capacity, services, apps, protection and shares, with a popout for all of it. The item can be added to the bar more than once, each with its own variant.

schema.label: What the bar shows
schema.description: Default is the active alert count when anything is firing, otherwise the fullest pool's capacity. Icon is the glyph alone, tinted by the worst state. Alerts is the active alert count. Capacity is the fullest pool. Pool is the worst pool status word. Temp is the hottest disk, or nothing when no temperature is known. Full adds alerts and capacity. Severity prints the worst two alert buckets, each tinted by its own level. Down counts the services and apps not running, and Protection the failed protection jobs, each blank when there is nothing to say. Uptime is the time since boot. The four chart variants draw in the icon slot: CapacityBar fills cells to the fullest pool's used percent with the percent beside them, Pools shows one square per pool coloured by status, DiskHeat one square per disk coloured by temperature band, and Sparkline a micro column chart of the fullest pool's recent capacity. Custom draws the pieces switched on below, in a fixed order with text and charts mixed, each dropped when it has nothing to say. An unreachable or unconfigured NAS overrides every variant with a plug or cog: a number the plugin cannot vouch for is never printed as one, and a chart with nothing to draw is empty.

schema.label: Custom: state glyph
schema.description: Lead the Custom item with the state glyph, the same mark the presets show.

schema.label: Custom: alert buckets
schema.description: The worst two non-empty alert buckets, each tinted.

schema.label: Custom: services and apps down
schema.description: How many services and apps are not running.

schema.label: Custom: protection failures
schema.description: How many replication, cloud sync, snapshot and scrub jobs have failed.

schema.label: Custom: capacity percent
schema.description: The fullest pool's used percent as text.

schema.label: Custom: capacity bar
schema.description: Six cells filled to the fullest pool's used percent, with the percent beside them.

schema.label: Custom: pool status word
schema.description: The worst pool's status word, e.g. ONLINE or DEGRADED.

schema.label: Custom: pool squares
schema.description: One square per pool, coloured by status.

schema.label: Custom: disk heat
schema.description: One square per disk, coloured by its temperature band.

schema.label: Custom: capacity sparkline
schema.description: A micro column chart of the fullest pool's recent capacity.

schema.label: Custom: uptime
schema.description: The time since the NAS booted, e.g. up 18h.

schema.label: Hide the icon when everything is healthy
schema.description: Off keeps a dimmed glyph on the bar, which is also how you tell the plugin is alive and reaching the NAS.

schema.label: Config file
schema.description: Leave empty for ~/.config/omarchy/truenas/config.json. The API key is never stored in shell.json: it lives in the credentials file the config names, at mode 600.
